$comment: PROVENANCE — READ BEFORE USING THIS AS A MODEL. This schema is AUTHORED FICTION. It was written for this sample overlay and is DEFINITIVE for the fictional deployment it describes; there is no external system it approximates. It demonstrates the ingress-mapping pattern (ADR-0030 Stage 2) and it does NOT attest that any real-world schema has been validated, reverse-engineered, or agreed with any producer. The distinction matters because a REAL overlay's wire schema is usually the opposite provenance class: a RECONSTRUCTION inferred from observed traffic or producer code because no contract or ICD was supplied — weak provenance, real referent. This specimen is strong provenance, fictional referent. It is more authoritative than a real overlay's schema, about far less. Do not infer from this file's confidence that a real deployment's schema carries equivalent authority; that inference is exactly backwards. See PRINCIPLES.md 'Claims vs. sources' and overlay-manifest.yaml class 'wire-schemas'.
description: Native wire shape of the fictional SENTRY-series ground sensor used by the sample deployment. Consumed from AMQP and mapped to the OpenDDIL Silver ontology by dynamic-mappings/sample-sensor-mapping.yaml. All identifiers, sites, nations and platform names herein are invented.

sensor_id.description: Native sensor identity. The sample deployment's convention encodes originating nation and site as underscore-delimited leading segments: <NATION>_<SITE>_<SYSTEM>_<ROLE>. The mapping parses the nation prefix to stamp Provenance.originator_nation (ADR-0029). Nations here are FICTIONAL.

platform_type.description: Native platform designation. Aliased to a canonical OpenDDIL platform_variant via ontology/platform_variant_aliases.yaml (ADR-0016) — the mapping never hardcodes the translation.

sequence.description: Monotonic source sequence. Enables drop detection downstream.

position.description: Geodetic position. Units are the SOURCE's native units and are carried verbatim as Quantity — no conversion in the mapping (ADR-0013).

mode.description: COMBINED state enum — the pedagogically important field. The source collapses power, activity and health into ONE value, which is exactly the shape ADR-0026 exists to decompose. The mapping expands it into three orthogonal axes (PowerState x FunctionalMode x HealthState) plus discrete RX/TX cues. A future source with a different combined vocabulary changes only its own mapping; the Silver shape is unchanged.

releasable_to.description: Nations this asset's data may be released to (ADR-0029). FICTIONAL nation codes. Absent means 'originator only'.

subsystems.description: Optional per-subsystem health. Mapped to constraining factors downstream, not interpreted here.
